audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN at 6/10 on a 35.14% win rate over 37 games, against a page that says 'you can't kill a tank with this', 'a duel you can't win' and 'Sion reclaims everything by 2+ items'.
audit.why: 35% is one of the worst numbers on the champion, and the level chart already gives Sion five of the seven rows. Nothing supports even.
audit.corrected: diffRating and carryRating to 8/10, with difficulty, carry, late and the final-rating line following. 'diff' (EVEN) and 'tone' are too short to replace inside the +/-10% band — flagged.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items spike says only that Sion 'out-scales into a perma-shoving, unkillable frontline'; his ultimate and his passive — the two things that actually change at scale — are never described.
audit.why: Unstoppable Onslaught is 140/100/60s with 7500 range and 'knocks them up based on the distance he has charged' — by rank 3 it is a 60-second, screen-crossing engage, which is what makes a fed Sion a map problem rather than a lane problem. Glory in Death is the other half: 'After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.' Killing him starts a second fight you have to win.
audit.corrected: R scales from 140s to 60s and the knockup grows with charge distance; the corpse heals off max-health autos, so anti-heal matters after he dies, not before.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two wrong mechanics repeated across the page. (a) Roar of the Slayer is called 'shield-break poke' in four places. (b) The page says Sion's damage is 'bonus-HP physical' and that Galio's magic-amped W 'barely cushions him'.
audit.why: Riot on Roar of the Slayer: 'Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.' It shreds armour and can fire a minion through you — it breaks no shields at all. Riot on Soul Furnace: 'Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby.' So a real chunk of his kit is magic, and Shield of Durand's amplified reduction does bite on it. Telling the player their W is dead weight here is the opposite of true.
audit.corrected: Roar of the Slayer is an armour shred with a minion-knockback line; Soul Furnace's detonation is magic damage, so charge W into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Decimating Smash with no numbers.
audit.why: Decimating Smash 10/9/8/7/6s, Soul Furnace 15/14/13/12/11s, Roar of the Slayer 12/11/10/9/8s at 800 range, Unstoppable Onslaught 140/100/60s, against Justice Punch at 11/10/9/8/7s. The Q is a charge, so the tell is the wind-up, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Numbers into the cooldown block, winCon, phases[2] and loading; the Soul Furnace detonation window (3 seconds after the shield) named as the punish.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] says 'Build penetration/anti-tank (not MR — his damage is physical)', and the itemization line sells Oblivion Orb for 'his healing'.
audit.why: Soul Furnace's detonation is magic, so blanket 'not MR' is wrong. And the only healing in Sion's kit is Glory in Death, which only exists after he dies — so the Grievous Wounds timing is 'before you take the kill', not 'early'. _missing-interactions also flags resistances-invalidated: Glory in Death and Soul Furnace both scale off max health, so stacking raw resistances alone reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal repositioned to the corpse phase; the MR advice corrected to note the magic component.

edits.before: Sion owns the opening: his charged Q (Decimating Smash) knocks you up, and his E (Roar of the Slayer) shield-break poke and W's AOE clear out-shove your single level-1 ability, so concede the first wave and last-hit from range. Your one early window is Level 3 once Q-W-E is up — bait him into committing a long Q charge, sidestep it or absorb it during your W channel, then release the W taunt into an E (Justice Punch) knockup. But understand the ceiling: you can't kill a tank with this, you're just buying enough respect that he stops free-shoving you in.
edits.after: Sion owns the opening: his charged Q (Decimating Smash) knocks you up, and Roar of the Slayer poke plus Soul Furnace's clear out-shove your single level-1 ability, so concede the first wave and last-hit from range. Roar of the Slayer also shreds your armour and, if it clips a minion, fires that minion through you — so don't stand behind the wave. Your one early window is Level 3 once Q-W-E is up: bait a long Q charge, sidestep or absorb it during your W charge, then release the taunt into a Justice Punch knockup.

edits.before: This is the wrong fantasy for Galio — your kit is built to eat an AP assassin's burst with a magic-amplified W and punish the over-commit, but Sion deals bonus-HP physical damage, never over-commits, and shrugs off a taunt. Your shield blocks little of his damage and accomplishes nothing offensively, and he just perma-shoves you with W's clear and E poke to deny the roam you actually want. Level 6 is your only real swing: Hero's Entrance lets you flag a winning lane and roam, converting your lane stalemate into a lead somewhere else instead of throwing it on a duel you can't win.
edits.after: This is the wrong fantasy for Galio — your kit is built to eat an assassin's burst and punish the over-commit, and Sion never over-commits. One thing the page used to get wrong: Soul Furnace's detonation is MAGIC damage, so your amplified reduction does bite there; charge W into the three-second window between his shield and its pop. What you cannot fix is the shove — Soul Furnace clear and Roar of the Slayer poke pin you in and deny the roam you want. Level 6 is your real swing: Hero's Entrance flags a winning lane and converts a stalemate into a lead somewhere else.

edits.before: Sion reclaims everything by 2+ items — he out-scales into a near-unkillable bonus-HP frontline while your damage and durability plateau, so never try to 1v1 him for the side wave. Your value is entirely the map: R presence, picking flanks, and peeling your carries off his Q engage in fights. Treat the lane as a hold, win the rest of the map with Hero's Entrance, and don't let a perma-shoving Sion bait you into a fight where your magic-skewed shield and taunt do little to a physical-damage tank.
edits.after: Sion reclaims everything by 2+ items — and Unstoppable Onslaught drops to 60 seconds at rank 3 with 7500 range, so the knockup that scales with charge distance arrives from off-screen. Never 1v1 him for the side wave. Your value is the map: R presence, flanks, and peeling your carries off his charge. One rule for when you do kill him: Glory in Death makes his corpse hit off your max health and heal from it, so put Grievous Wounds on before the killing blow, not after.

notes: 'Shield-break poke' for Roar of the Slayer appeared four times and is not a thing — the ability shreds armour and can knock a minion back through a line of enemies, both of which are more actionable than the phantom shield-break. The bigger correction is the damage-type claim: the page told the Galio player his magic-amplified W was dead weight because Sion is 'bonus-HP physical', but Riot types Soul Furnace's reactivation as Magic Damage, so there is a real three-second window every 15 seconds where charging W is correct. Anti-heal advice was also mistimed — Sion's only kit healing is Glory in Death, which exists only after he dies, so Grievous Wounds has to be applied before the killing blow, not 'early'. I did NOT claim Unstoppable Onslaught is CC-immune despite its name and despite _missing-interactions asserting 'Your Unstoppable Onslaught (R) shuts off Galio's Justice Punch (E)' from Sion's side — Riot's description says only that he charges, steers, damages and knocks up by distance, and the kit's needsResearch is empty, which means unknown rather than no. UNVERIFIED and left alone: whether Galio's taunt or R knockup can stop the charge. full.diff still reads EVEN on a 35% matchup.
